s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions with systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions on the face, chest, abdomen, and limbs
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein
key_facts: The patient is a child weighing 30 kg
The patient has no comorbidities or allergies
The patient is not taking any long-term medications
The patient has erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions on the face, chest, abdomen, and limbs
The patient reported frequent contact with stray cats
Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate is 47 mm/h
C-reactive protein is 25.8 mg/L
White blood cell count is 15,390/uL
Eosinophils are 11%
IgE level is 7200 μg/L
